topic: A fifteen minute weekly money check-in vs never looking (Rowan vs Cleo)

scenes.narration: Fifteen minutes each Sunday caught two thousand dollars in leaks. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled NEVER LOOK and SUNDAY CHECK IN, comic burst banner reads TWO THOUSAND IN LEAKS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rowan and Cleo both earn fifty thousand and feel broke.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man rowan and woman cleo sitting on benches with empty wallets, chalkboard stamped FIFTY THOUSAND EACH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Neither one has ever reviewed a full month of transactions.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, rowan and cleo staring at long unread bank statements curling across a gym floor, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rowan checks his balance only when a card gets declined.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, rowan at a gym smoothie counter with a card reader stamped DECLINED, shocked expression, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Overdrafts, duplicate charges, and a forgotten trial slip by unnoticed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, leaks dripping from rowan's wallet labeled OVERDRAFT DUPLICATE CHARGE FORGOTTEN TRIAL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cleo blocks fifteen minutes every Sunday morning with her coffee.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cleo at a gym table with coffee and a timer reading FIFTEEN MINUTES, calendar stamped SUNDAY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She scans transactions, checks balances, and plans the coming week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cleo ticking a checklist labeled TRANSACTIONS BALANCES PLAN THE WEEK on a clipboard, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Week one she spots a double charge and a zombie trial.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cleo circling two lines on a statement stamped DOUBLE CHARGE and ZOMBIE TRIAL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rowan paid four hundred twenty dollars in overdraft fees this year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, rowan slumped beside a gym scoreboard reading FOUR HUNDRED TWENTY IN FEES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cleo caught nineteen hundred dollars of errors, fees, and drift.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cleo flexing beside a gym scoreboard reading NINETEEN HUNDRED RECOVERED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thirteen hours of Sunday check ins protected nearly two thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cleo holding a stopwatch labeled THIRTEEN HOURS beside a locker stamped TWO THOUSAND SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Book fifteen minutes every Sunday for a money check in. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
